common.featureDisabled: This feature is not enabled on the connected backend.

connection.apiBaseHint: Origin only — the client appends /v1 itself. Leave blank to use the current origin.
connection.tokenHint: Stored per-backend; switching the API base swaps to that backend's token.

gate.cannotConnectHint: Check the API base in the connection panel (top right) and make sure the databench service is running.
gate.clientTooOld: This backend requires frontend client {{min}} or newer, but this client is {{current}}. Please update the console.
gate.apiUnsupported: This console does not support the backend API version "{{api}}". Please update the console or point it at a compatible backend.
gate.incompatibleHint: You can point the console at a different backend from the connection panel (top right).

datasets.title: Datasets / Refs
datasets.description: Named refs from /v1/refs. Each ref points to the latest dataset version. Open a ref or a version to inspect its manifest and samples.
datasets.emptyNoRefs: No refs yet. Ingest a dataset to get started.

detail.description: Resolved dataset version with samples, lineage, and export actions.
detail.manifestDescription: Advanced metadata and raw JSON for this resolved version.
detail.exportHint: streams the full dataset as NDJSON from /v1/datasets/{ref}/export
detail.pageSizeHint: Samples load lazily as you scroll (server cap {{max}}/page).
detail.emptyRange: This dataset has no samples in this range.

ingest.jsonlDisabled: JSONL ingest is not enabled on the connected backend.
ingest.createDescription: Paste a JSON array of samples; posts to /v1/datasets.
ingest.errExpectArray: Expected a JSON array of samples.

transforms.title: Transforms
transforms.selectPrompt: Select a transform to run it.
transforms.inputsLabel: Inputs (refs/versions, one per line or comma-separated)
transforms.errNeedInput: Provide at least one input ref/version.
transforms.errParamsObject: Params must be a JSON object.

recipe.title: Materialize recipe
recipe.description: Paste a recipe object; posts to /v1/recipes:materialize and returns the resulting dataset manifest.
recipe.errRecipeObject: Recipe must be a JSON object.

lineage.title: Lineage / Provenance
lineage.disabled: Lineage is not enabled on the connected backend.
lineage.placeholder: ref or version, e.g. my-dataset or sha256:…
lineage.emptyPrompt: Enter a ref/version to inspect its provenance DAG.

vocab.title: Vocabularies
vocab.description: Controlled term registries from /v1/vocabularies. Derive a draft from a dataset's labels, then curate it into a canonical vocabulary.
vocab.disabled: Vocabularies are not enabled on the connected backend.
vocab.emptyNone: No vocabularies yet. Derive one from a dataset to get started.
vocab.needsReviewHint: These aliases were seen mapping to more than one canonical during derivation. A curator should confirm the chosen mapping before promoting to curated.
vocab.curateHint: Edit each term's aliases (comma-separated). Submitting enforces the strict invariant server-side: unique canonicals, one canonical per alias, aliases disjoint from canonicals.
vocab.deriveDescription: Derive a draft vocabulary from a dataset's labels via POST /v1/vocabularies/{name}:derive.
vocab.extractorHint: Leave blank to use the server preset for known dimensions. Provide keys to extract from the last assistant turn's JSON.
vocab.errRequired: Name, dataset and dimension are required.
vocab.errExtractorKeys: Provide both raw key and std key, or leave the extractor blank.
vocab.applyDescription: Validate a dataset's labels against this vocabulary, or normalize them to canonical terms. The extractor is resolved server-side from this vocabulary; a new content-addressed dataset is persisted.
vocab.applyDatasetPlaceholder: ref or version, e.g. my-dataset or sha256:…
vocab.createDescription: Build a vocabulary by hand: give it a name, a dimension, and add terms with their aliases. Submitting enforces the strict invariant server-side: unique canonicals, one canonical per alias, aliases disjoint from canonicals.

gate.absent: This backend does not advertise the Post-training V2 capability.
gate.disabled: The backend has the V2 contract installed, but release access is currently disabled.
gate.unauthorized: Provide valid credentials in the connection panel to access Post-training V2.
gate.forbidden: Your current identity does not have access to Post-training V2.
gate.network: The V2 capability could not be checked because the backend is unreachable.
gate.incompatible: The backend is enabled but is missing one or more required protocol profiles.
gate.clientIncompatible: The connected backend is not compatible with this console version.

datasets.title: Post-training datasets
datasets.description: Named V2 refs available to the current connection. Detached snapshots are not listed here.
datasets.empty: No V2 refs are visible to this connection.

detail.description: This page is pinned to one immutable dataset version while you inspect records.
detail.newVersion: This ref now points to {{version}}. The current record session remains pinned.

conflict.title: The ref changed
conflict.description: The dataset was committed safely, but the ref compare-and-set failed. Choose an explicit recovery action; nothing is overwritten automatically.

ingest.title: Ingest canonical JSONL
ingest.description: Upload canonical record JSONL and optionally update a named ref with compare-and-set.
ingest.fileHint: The browser streams the file directly to the V2 API.
ingest.refHint: Leave blank to commit only the immutable dataset without creating or moving a ref.
ingest.expectedHint: For an existing ref, enter its current exact version. Conflicts are never overwritten automatically.
ingest.expectedNeedsRef: An expected version requires an output ref.
ingest.messageNeedsRef: A ref message requires an output ref.

transforms.title: V2 transforms
transforms.description: Combine immutable inputs in an explicit order and run deterministic transforms with server-validated parameters.
transforms.empty: The server provides no V2 transforms.
transforms.identityPreserve: Preserve mode retains each output record's input identity; the server enforces its constraints.
transforms.identityDerive: Derive mode creates new record identities from the transform semantics.
transforms.inputsHint: Order participates in transform identity. Use the controls to move an input explicitly.
transforms.inputRequired: At least one input ref or exact version is required.
transforms.paramsHint: The UI checks only JSON object syntax. The server validates fields and constraints against its schema.
transforms.paramsObject: Parameters must be a JSON object.
transforms.expectedHint: Enter this when updating an existing ref to enable explicit CAS.
transforms.expectedNeedsRef: An expected version requires an output ref.
transforms.messageNeedsRef: A ref message requires an output ref.
transforms.resolvingRef: Resolving the output ref's current version…
transforms.newRef: This output ref does not exist yet and will be created after success.
transforms.refLookupFailed: The output ref's current version could not be read.

lineage.title: V2 lineage
lineage.description: Read a bounded lineage graph from a pinned exact dataset version under server limits.
lineage.graphLabel: Directed lineage graph of immutable dataset versions and producing runs
lineage.empty: This snapshot has no visible lineage nodes.

export.title: Inspect and export
export.description: Pin an exact version, inspect its fidelity plan, then download deterministic output with the same digest.
export.optionsHint: Inspection returns the server-normalized options used for download.
export.optionsObject: Converter options must be a JSON object.
export.optionsInvalid: Converter options are not valid JSON: {{message}}
export.confirmSemantic: I reviewed and explicitly accept the semantic changes in this exact plan. A changed plan requires new confirmation.
export.planDrifted: The server rejected the old digest and returned a new fidelity plan. The old approval was cleared; review and confirm again.
export.cancelled: Download cancelled and was not reported as successful.
export.useCli: The browser safety limit was reached. Stream the same export with this CLI command:

downloadError.content_type: The response media type did not match the inspected plan, so the download stopped safely.
downloadError.empty_stream: The server did not return an export byte stream.
downloadError.size_limit: The export exceeded the safe in-memory browser download limit.
downloadError.stream_failed: The export stream ended before completion; the partial file was not reported as successful.

records.empty: This immutable snapshot contains no records.
records.listLabel: Record summaries. Use arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, or End to navigate the virtual list.

record.description: Complete canonical record rendered from the exact immutable dataset version.
record.title: Record identity
record.jsonPreparing: Preparing JSON off the main thread…
record.jsonError: JSON could not be prepared safely.
record.jsonTooLarge: This record is too large for an in-page preview. Download the prepared JSON instead.
record.textTruncated: Large text preview ({{count}} characters). The full value is available as a controlled download.

readError.not_found: The requested ref, snapshot, or record is not available to this connection.
readError.unauthorized: Update the connection credentials before retrying this private V2 read.
readError.forbidden: The current identity cannot read this V2 resource.
readError.network: The read could not complete because the backend connection failed.
readError.validation: The requested identifier or page is not valid for this API.
readError.other: The read failed safely. Retry or return to the V2 refs list.
readError.integrity: This snapshot cannot be displayed or ignored. Run the server audit, copy the diagnostic ID, or return to the refs list.

errors.unreachable: Cannot reach the backend. Is the databench service running?
errors.notDatabench: Connected to a server, but it didn't return a databench API response. Point the console at a databench backend from the connection panel (top right).
